LM.PPL: exp(corpus NLL), never mean per-example PPL
LM.causal_shift: position t predicts valid nucleotide t+1
LM.corpus_aggregation: FP64 sum(valid loss sums)/sum(valid target counts)
LM.overflow: Preserve finite NLL; PPL null with explicit overflow reason if not finite; exclude only affected nonfinite PPL draw from that quantity mask and report counts
LM.valid_targets: positive,L-1 valid nucleotide targets; exact inherited ambiguous-base/masking behavior; no fillers/padding

audit.GPU_smoke_rule: S03 provenance only1e-4+1e-5*abs(reference), not metric tolerance
audit.failure: Preserve failure and producer. Quarantine affected release; no replacement unit or tolerance widening. Repair gets new source/unit attempt/receipt, dependency-scoped invalidation and immutable release overlay
audit.fresh_refit: Frozen126unit panel repeats full TRAIN CV+final fit independently; never replace production head; H3subset reused by exact S05 receipts in S08
audit.saved_output: Independent reconstruction of every new probability path/point/paired vector/mask/CI, all26layers, no aggregate-only validation

three_outcomes: Signed observed positive/negative reference association with direction and limitations
Uncertain or practically ambiguous difference, no equivalence inference
Ineligible edge, null values and exact reason

endpoints.base: Compatible original-base contrasts are reference-checkpoint differences, never assumed before/after intervention effects
endpoints.causal: Unknown exact immediate parent/intervention/exposure => no parent-relative/matched-dose causal edge
endpoints.new_candidate: Outside this freeze until separately authorized versioned prospective update
endpoints.noise5: Include steps2000 and2151 as separate descriptive endpoints; no primary winner, averaging or replicate interpretation

execution.chunking: Contiguous frozen row order, physical8 fillers lastbatch excluded; one writer per identity; temp fsync/atomic rename then seal last
execution.later_calibration: S05 first permitted TRAIN-only extraction chunk measures throughput and peak memory after new S05approval; do not run it in S04
execution.one_forward_bundle: One candidate/task/split with all hooks+actualLM; shared by all seeds/policies
execution.resume: Run/attempt/package/supplement/protocol pins, completed seals, unfinished exact keys/offsets/bytes, PID/start/boot and lock state, unresolved affected scopes, exact next permitted action/prerequisites; reconcile live state before scheduling
execution.reuse: Exact source/runtime/cohort/input/output seal only. S03smoke is not production reuse. Failed attempts preserved; no duplicate writers
execution.stage_boundary: No watchers, prompt fetching by workers or auto stage advancement

extension_policy.forget: S10 checkpoint/protocol/cohort-matched collaborator aggregates only; unavailable uncertainty stays null; no raw data request or evaluation
extension_policy.new_metadata: Does not silently activate deferred comparisons; updated eligibility release needs prospective scope/version record
extension_policy.versioning: Append-only new freeze with source/candidate change, exact affected keys, direct authority and outcome-exposure statement. Preserve original plan/results; no retroactive edits

rules.layer_indexing: decoder.layers.16 is zero-based index16, the17th block

metrics.binary: Sorted classes[0,1], positive numeric1, prediction probability>=0.5
metrics.cross_entropy: float64 probabilities; sklearn1.7.2 log_loss and matching independent float64-epsilon clipping; natural log
metrics.main_focus: AUROC at both anchors. Seed42 compact examples by fixed rule,17/1234 sensitivity. All metrics/layers/seeds retained; not a confirmatory family
metrics.splice: Sorted classes[0,1,2], macroOVR AUROC, mean classwiseAP, argmax decision, macro recall

outcome_exposure.S03: Only exact12TRAIN technical witness activations/LM inspected; no production/dev/test science
outcome_exposure.historical: A-series outcomes including previously examined H3 test exist; this plan does not retrospectively preregister examined contrasts
outcome_exposure.planning_access: Cohort/fold/group/reference/draw metadata only; no sequence or prediction/score values used for selection

probe.fixed_original_base: Exact original-base scaler/head unchanged, no recenter/calibration/refit/parent-head swap
probe.retry: Fresh identical TRAIN-only pipeline retry at10000 only after inherited ConvergenceWarning. Log every warning/n_iter/attempt; unresolved or other warning blocks affected unit. No hyperparameter/data/tolerance changes
probe.scaler: StandardScaler fits only current training fold; final fit allTRAIN
probe.selection: Arithmetic mean fold AUROC; exact ties choose smaller C

runtime.backend: Source-bound original native Evo2-1B from S03, unchanged
runtime.filler_rows: Excluded from IDs,features,losses,target counts and reported logical rows
runtime.hooks: All26 in one forward, layer capture locations as S03
runtime.model_precision: Exactly qualified BF16/FP32 promotions/TE unfused, no new quantization or runtime changes
runtime.pooling: Masked mean over valid nucleotide positions
runtime.source_change: Version affected dependencies; requalify only affected units under separately approved phase

seed_semantics.CV: Probe training partition sensitivity, never independent intervention replication

rules.test_scope: EXCLUDED; historical H3 test1497 is not copied or admitted

uncertainty.CV_seed_ranges: Sensitivity only, never CI or independent replicates
uncertainty.LM_draw: Recompute sum(loss)/sum(targets) in draw using group multiplicities; exponentiate ratio for PPL
uncertainty.classifier_validity: Every required numeric class present in draw; endpoint finite checks also required. Marginal mask is class-complete AND finite for that quantity; paired mask is explicit intersection of both marginal masks on the exact same draw IDs
uncertainty.difference: Compute target-minus-reference within each common valid draw, not subtract CI endpoints
uncertainty.draw_generation: Reuse exact restored int32 group_draws. Never regenerate for favorable validity
uncertainty.excluded_variability: Intervention training/seed variability, fitted-head training uncertainty and unknown homology/locus dependence not covered
uncertainty.group_order: numpy.unique lexically sorted names; inherited inverse row-group order
uncertainty.groups: Exact/reverse-complement groups; no claim of biological independence
uncertainty.interval: numpy.quantile(valid differences,[.025,.975],method=linear), inherited default; independent atol1e-12 rtol0
uncertainty.label: pointwise_exploratory_conditional
uncertainty.margin_null_reason: No justified prospective margin authorized; interval crossing zero is inconclusive
uncertainty.missing: null with explicit reason; attempted/valid/invalid and mask hashes; zero common valid draws => nullCI and affected inferential release blocked, retain valid point description separately
uncertainty.multiplicity: Pointwise unadjusted exploratory conditional intervals. No full-grid/FWER claim. No new confirmatory test
